title: Composable learned causal relation versus fully fitted conventional structure learners
source_language: Python 3.13.5; NumPy 2.3.5, sklearn 1.8.0, SciPy 1.17.0; single-thread BLAS/OMP/MKL

earlier_excluded_smoke.status: implementation smoke executed before freeze; no tuning from scored outcomes; do not include in gate

primary_screen.source_laws: OLD: one unknown 2-way parity coefficient +0.85 and one unknown disjoint 3-way parity coefficient -0.5; NEW: one fifth/sixth-order parity coefficient randomly ±0.7 (except same_law), built from OLD 2-way support plus unseen variables or entirely unrelated 5-way support in unrelated_fifth. Supports selected under independent numpy SeedSequence([seed,family_id,world_id,71]), not exposed to fitting.

hypothesis: A candidate that builds new 5th/6th-order relation proposals by composing OLD supports it actually learned with previously unused action variables, choosing an evidence-backed proposal, beats the strongest trained nonoracle control on disjoint held intervention consequences by >=5% MSE, with functional OLD-return MSE drift <=0.02 and competitive whole-process cost.
candidate: 2-term OLD OMP fit from 128 witnessed OLD interventions; construct every degree5/6 union of learned OLD support and other action bits (never planted support indices); train NEW residual one-factor fit on 96 actual observations, validate on 32 disjoint, admit if MSE gain>=0.005; refit on all128 NEW witnesses. OLD weights stored and restored read-only; no hidden oracle or held answer leakage.

controls.full_sparse: Same OLD baseline and 96/32 NEW validation, searches full preauthored 4th-6th-order Walsh dictionary with same one-factor fit/refit rule.
controls.elasticnet: Same OLD baseline, NEW residuals; all 4th-6th-order Walsh supports fitted ElasticNet l1=0.9, validation alphas 0.008/0.025/0.075, max_iter4000 tol1e-6, refit 128.
controls.extra_trees: Same OLD baseline and NEW residuals; raw 9 action bits+learned OLD prediction, fully fitted ExtraTrees with 96 trees, validation leaves2/5, refit NEW128, n_jobs1.
controls.uniform_bayes: Analytic conjugate Gaussian one-novel-feature mixture over all 4th-6th-order Walsh supports, known assumed noise sigma0.22, Gaussian coefficient prior precision0.1, explicit 50% null prior; matched128 NEW witnessed residuals.
controls.old_only: Same OLD learned readout without NEW adaptation.
controls.shuffled: Candidate composition proposal library from observed old support, but NEW train and validation residual outcomes separately shuffled by fixed source-keyed seed 7101; includes no correct NEW supervision.
controls.oracle: Only for result auditing; planted support never exposed to candidate or controls; no oracle modeled as fair arm.

metrics: Mean NEW cold held MSE (lower better), by seed and family; OLD return held MSE before/after checkpoint JSON cold restore (absolute); per-arm fit+inference elapsed on single CPU, includes common OLD fitting and feature generation; no measurement of physical energy. Source identity, per-world receipts, semantic replay required.

frozen_gates.global_5pct: candidate mean cold MSE <=0.95*minimum over full_sparse,elasticnet,extra_trees,uniform_bayes pooled.
frozen_gates.three_of_four_seeds: candidate cold MSE <=0.95*strongest eligible conventional within at least 3/4 seeds.
frozen_gates.two_of_three_novel_families: candidate <=0.95*strongest conventional in at least 2/3 novel families compose_fifth,compose_sixth,unrelated_fifth.
frozen_gates.every_family_5pct_guard: candidate <=1.05*strongest conventional within EVERY family including unchanged law.
frozen_gates.old_return_abs_mse_regression_0p02: every world's post-restore OLD held MSE <=pre-update OLD held MSE+0.02 absolute units.
frozen_gates.shuffled_negative_20pct: candidate pooled NEW held MSE <=0.8*shuffled negative.
frozen_gates.max_twice_fastest_whole_process: candidate summed cold fit+inference elapsed <=2x fastest conventional summed elapsed. Per-case runtime includes OLD fit; no wall physical energy claim.

decision: SCREEN_GO_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY if all seven pass AND independent source/case audit PASS; else SCREEN_NO_GO. Any source/split/seed/held leakage or drift -> INVALID. A screen GO never constitutes SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native Yggdrasil acceptance.
limitations: Synthesized action-consequence worlds, not real outside environment
Cold means disjoint action identities within fitted law, not no-retraining zero-shot cross-world transfer
Old retention via frozen checkpoint is not shared-representation interference proof
Finite preauthored composition operator grammar, not open-ended relation invention
Trained controls differ in compute, while data/actions/old baseline are identical
No native Yggdrasil model/weight/owner/acceptance/first-use and no paid APIs
isolation: No merges, accepted main, model weights or native architecture updates
No controller, queue, runner, scheduler or deployment actions
No additional tuning on consumed screen seeds or rerunning screen after score
All negative outcomes preserved on current draft archive PR
